messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search
function.description: Search movies based on a set of specified criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The release year of the movie.

genre.description: The genre of the movie. Default: 'science fiction'

message.content:
截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房收入最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009 年上映）。根据最新统计数据，该片在全球累计票房约为 29 亿美元（约合 290 亿人民币），保持着单部影片最高票房纪录。  

> **注**：如果按通货膨胀调整后计算，排名可能会有所变化；但就名义票房而言，《阿凡達》仍然是第一位。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie ever?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains the highest worldwide grossing film at about $2.92 billion. But we need to confirm with the function? The function is movies_search, but it only searches movies based on title, year, and optional genre. It doesn't provide ranking or box office data. So we cannot use the function to answer this question. We can answer directly: "Avatar" is the highest-grossing film worldwide. Or mention "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide context. Also note that inflation-adjusted numbers might differ. Provide answer in Chinese.
